submit as my report as follows:

facts under Section 102 and 110 of the Companies Act, 2013 was sent to the shareholders of
the Company

reports generated from the e-voting system provided by National Securities Depository
Limited, the authorised agency to provide e-voting facilities, engaged by the Company.
